goal: 在 A.1 下新建 A.1.3「设计史分期与解释框架」，把大历史观、长时段、轴心时代、阶段性突破推进、变与统、本元特征、六大设计文化区域、南秀北雄、《中国大历史》与雅斯贝斯集中挂载；同批把「艺术设计史」术语补入既有 A.1.2。
unresolved: The methodological boundary and falsifiability conditions of the macro-history perspective are not recorded; the criteria for 'coarse rather than fine' periodization are absent
Longue duree is only one item in a list of foreign periodization models; Li Lixin does not state whether the book adopts it, and gives no definition or design-history application
The Axial Age is cited and then limited as insufficient to grasp Chinese history; the scope of that limitation and any alternative framework are not developed
Stage-by-stage breakthrough advancement exists only as a theory name and evaluation in Zhang Daoyi's preface; its reference relation to Li Lixin's three-period division is not stated by the source
Bian-yu-tong has no school origin, no relation to dynastic-unification historiography, and no quantified indicators for each period
Footnote 1 attached to Benyuan Tezheng is unread; the definitional boundary between 'benyuan' and 'shiyuanxing' is not recorded
The six design culture regions are given only by name with a 'fully corresponding' judgment; dates, geographic boundaries, artifact traits and the basis of partition are missing
Nan Xiu Bei Xiong is Zhao Nong's classroom generalization about Southern and Northern Dynasties taste, with no definition, proposer or systematic argument; it is not treated as a stylistic law
Whether these frameworks are mutually compatible or can form a unified periodization system is not discussed by the sources; A.1.3 does not synthesize them
Themes for dimension E remain unmaterialized; Panama-Pacific Exposition, 1851 Great Exhibition, foreign-style architecture terms and qipao stay as cross-theme debts
2412 KUs remain unmounted; A.1 does not close dimension A
